answer: Agents anchor to 1,000 unique spatial sectors by validating signal latency against audited maps to defeat relay fraud. An honest node covers the physical traversal cost for one site, while a sybil farm of 1,000 identities faces linear movement expenses for signal parity at every node. A verifier checks the plume of radio frequency drift, maps the karst terrain to detect echo anomalies, and scans the orchard edge to confirm signal freshness. Each identity must provide signed receipts with unique byte counts, and failures trigger a 144-hour asset lock.
